plugins.name: open-computer-use
plugins.description: Open-source Computer Use MCP server and skill (fork of opensymph/open-computer-use): control desktop apps on macOS, Linux, and Windows from AI agents via accessibility-first automation, with native macOS window management (window2) in this fork.
examplePrompts: Inspect the current UI state of this desktop app without stealing focus
List all open windows and read the accessibility tree of one specific window by its id
Open a new document with keyboard shortcuts, then type content into it
Check why open-computer-use cannot control this app and fix the setup
